member.name: T:OpenIGI.Modding.Loader.ModLoader
member.summary: Finds the mods a run plays with and loads their code.

remarks.para: The mods are the ones a switches on, in its order, as the launcher writes it; or, with no profile, every subdirectory of a folder holding a mod.json, in the order of the directories' names, so the order is the same on every machine. A mod that names an assembly is loaded into its own , which takes the port's own assemblies from the game rather than from the mod, so the mod's is the game's; its other dependencies are its own. The mod is the one public class of its assembly that implements , made through its public parameterless constructor.

A mod that cannot be read or loaded, was written for another API, reads a game that is not installed, needs a mod that is not played, or conflicts with one played before it is reported and left out; the rest are played with. A run without mods is the game as it ships, which is what the parity tests play.
